layouts.app_shell: Mobile-first responsive view. Use a bottom navigation tab bar (fixed bottom-0, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border-t border-border). Main content must have bottom padding to prevent overlap.
layouts.menu_grid: Bento-style layout for menu items. grid-cols-1 or md:grid-cols-2. Large hero cards for featured dishes (col-span-full), smaller squares for a la carte items.
layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8 for layout boundaries. Sections separated by py-12 or gap-8.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for bottom nav and sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl, border-t border-white/20). Neumorphism minimal cards for menu items (soft shadow, flat background, 1px subtle border).
visual_enhancers.corners: Subtle roundness. rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for food imagery containers to feel organic and friendly.
visual_enhancers.images: Hero imagery must have bg-black/30 overlay if text is placed on top. Food imagery should be edge-to-edge in cards.

components.button: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons use Terracotta (#B14F36) with hover lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
components.delivery_slot_picker: Horizontal scrollable date/time chips. Must feel tactile. Active state uses Secondary color (Ochre) background with primary text.
components.cart_stepper: Quantity toggles (+/-) should be rounded, clearly bounded by border-border, with generous hit areas.
components.timeline: For order tracking. Vertical line with circular nodes. Active nodes in Primary color, pulsing animation (animate-pulse) on the current active step.
components.navigation: BottomTab pattern: Home, Menu, Cart, Profile. Use lucide-react icons.

curries_and_bowls.description: Dark bowls with rich indian curries

motion.page_transitions: Slide up and fade in for new screens or tab switches.
motion.list_items: Staggered entrance animations for menu lists.
motion.interactions: Haptic-style bounce on cart add. Scale-down on button press (active:scale-95).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has background gradient or text-shadow.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, inputs, and functional UI elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a 'Mobile-First' Web App view since this is targeting a mobile delivery app. The layout should mimic a native mobile app shell.
Use standard React components using .js or .jsx extensions ONLY. Do NOT use .tsx as per project configuration.
Use 'Playfair Display' for all main headings (H1-H3) to give a high-end, slow-food feeling. Use 'Manrope' for standard text.
Use a bento-style layout for the Menu. Hero items should be large (col-span-full), side items can be square grids.
Use the Organic & Earthy palette. Base backgrounds should be warm Bone White (#FAF9F6) rather than pure white. Accent colors are Terracotta (#B14F36) and Ochre.
Implement bottom tab navigation (fixed bottom, glassmorphic backdrop) containing Home, Menu, Cart, Profile.
Delivery Slot Picker should be highly prominent, visually showing Friday evening and Saturday morning slots.
For Map placeholders, use a minimal map component or styled image layered with a vertical timeline tracker for orders.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header; if it overlaps scrolling content, use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent background.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or similar based on your .js setup
